name: Rip
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your attack power:   1 point : 300 damage over 12 sec.   2 points: 498 damage over 12 sec.   3 points: 696 damage over 12 sec.   4 points: 894 damage over 12 sec.   5 points: 1092 damage over 12 sec.
